name: Salter's Fireplace & Outdoor Living
hours: Tue to Fri 10 to 6. Sat 10 to 4.
description: Salter's Fireplace & Outdoor Living has warmed Southeastern PA since 1974 with fireplaces, stoves, inserts, grills, fire pits, patio furniture, and outdoor kitchens across two showrooms in Eagleville and Hatfield.

hero.headline: Fireplaces and outdoor living, from two showrooms
hero.sub: Over 50 years of fireplaces, stoves, inserts, grills, fire pits, patio furniture, and outdoor kitchens, on display in Eagleville and Hatfield.

offerings.heading: Inside the house and <mark>out back.</mark>
items: Fireplaces, stoves, and inserts in gas, wood, and electric
Grills, fire pits, patio furniture, and full outdoor kitchens
Service and repair for the fireplaces Salter's sells and the ones it did not
Hatfield showroom, 56 E Broad St, in the 1924 firehouse
Tue to Fri 10 to 6, Sat 10 to 4

gallery.heading: Fire, stone, and <mark>the rooms around them.</mark>

story.heading: Fifty years of Pennsylvania winters
paragraphs: Salter's opened in 1974 and never left Montgomery County. Eagleville on Ridge Pike is where most first visits start; Hatfield fills the original 1924 firehouse.
Both floors exist so a family can stand in front of a burning unit before buying it.

experience.heading: How a project runs
items: Visit either showroom Tuesday through Saturday and see the units lit.
Salter's measures the room or patio and quotes the install with the product.

feature.heading: The Hatfield Firehouse showroom
feature.text: Eight thousand six hundred square feet inside the 1924 firehouse at 56 E Broad Street, filled with fireplaces, grills, and outdoor living.
